name: @bytive/jewel-try-me
description: Virtual jewelry try-on React component powered by MediaPipe + Gemini.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun run build:css && bun run build:inject && bun run build:js && bun run sync:frontend
scripts.sync:frontend: rm -rf ../frontend/node_modules/@bytive/jewel-try-me/dist && mkdir -p ../frontend/node_modules/@bytive/jewel-try-me/dist && cp -r dist/* ../frontend/node_modules/@bytive/jewel-try-me/dist/ && cp package.json README.md ../frontend/node_modules/@bytive/jewel-try-me/
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run build
